title: deskpress theme
description: A theme is data: 23 semantic color tokens per theme, and no component ever branches on a theme name. One theme per person is normal here, not an edge case. Every theme is measured by the validator: the 13 contrast pairs must clear 4.5:1, because this app gets read outdoors with one hand.

default.description: Theme id used when nobody has been chosen yet.

color.description: Hex, 6 or 8 digits. No named colors and no gradients: every token is measured.

name.description: What a person sees on the handoff screen. Any language.

kid.description: Kid mode is an attribute of the screen, not a theme. This only marks a theme as intended for a kid: larger type, thicker borders, cards become kid boxes.

shadow.description: Only kid components have a shadow, and it is hard, with no blur.

colors.description: All 23 tokens, in every theme. A missing token is an error, not a default: the component that needed it would have rendered invisible.

paper.description: The screen. All contrast is measured against this.

ink.description: Text and main borders on paper.

ink-muted.description: Labels and secondary text. Never carries new information at 17px and up.

card.description: Card fill: the accent at 8% over paper.

rule.description: The 1px separator between rows of a list.

soft.description: Quiet fill for a control at rest.

alert.description: The alert component, and nothing else.

highlight-bg.description: The accent at 20%: the block being answered right now.

highlight-text.description: Secondary text inside a highlight. Measured against highlight-bg, not paper.

chip-bg.description: The 40px profile chip. Inverted against the bar it sits in.

bar-bg.description: Top and bottom bars, in full color.

missing-fill.description: The striped hole where a fact nobody confirmed would go.

x-contrast-pairs.description: The 13 pairs the validator measures at 4.5:1. Foreground first.
